name: Matacorn
description: Matacorn was a terrestrial world located in the Matacorn system, a part of the Mid Rim's Lambda sector. A nondescript trade world, it was the homeworld of the Human Hurst Romodi. Matacorn also shared its name with the Matacorn campaign, a part of the Galactic Civil War.
